ValidationRule.description: Locks the Opportunity Stage once it is set to 'Closed Won', preventing users from reverting a closed-won deal back into an open pipeline stage.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ISCHANGED(StageName) && ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), 'Closed Won') && NOT(ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Closed Won')) && NOT(ISCHANGED(SkipValidations__c))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This Opportunity is already closed; the stage can no longer be changed.
